title: 哥達基線隧道~Gotthard Base Tunnel
focus: 深覆土地應力、基線牽引與多工作面整合~Deep-cover stress, base-railway traction and multiple-heading integration
summary: 哥達基線隧道長57公里，瑞士官方記錄2016年投入營運，服務平緩跨阿爾卑斯鐵路。本進階課由牽引效益及覆土應力出發，連接支護時序、襯砌接頭、多工作面物流及精密貫通；最後比較岩體熱與列車壓力擾動，說明土建完成仍須完成系統介面驗證。~The 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entered service in 2016 as part of Switzerland’s low-gradient transalpine railway. This advanced course connects traction benefits and cover stress to support timing, lining joints, multiple-heading logistics and precision breakthrough. It then compares rock heat and train pressure disturbances, explaining why civil completion still requires verification of operating-system interfaces.

units.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求~Base-alignment grade and traction demand
units.mechanism: 哥達基線的低坡度目標必須和重載列車情境一起評估，減少坡度阻力不表示通風氣動與加速功率可忽略。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。~Assess Gotthard’s low-gradient purpose with heavy-train scenarios; reduced gravity resistance does not eliminate aerodynamic, acceleration or ventilation demands. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.24e+06 kg；縱坡=0.005 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1216.44 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1338.08 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.24e+06 kg; grade=0.005 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1216.44 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1338.08 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將同一列車在基線與假想山線上的逐段坡度功率比較，再分開制動和牽引需求。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare local grade power for one train on base and hypothetical mountain alignments, separating braking from traction. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 若只比較最高坡度而忽略長度和速度歷程，節能結論可能偏離整段旅程。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。~Comparing maximum grade without length and speed history can misstate whole-journey energy benefit. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.
units.misconception: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。~A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
units.practice: 本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：將同一列車在基線與假想山線上的逐段坡度功率比較，再分開制動和牽引需求。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。~For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Compare local grade power for one train on base and hypothetical mountain alignments, separating braking from traction. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.

units.anchor: 洞壁切向應力~Tangential wall stress
units.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配~Cover stress and wall redistribution
units.mechanism: 哥達深覆土的教學模型先分開遠場應力與洞壁集中，研究同一覆土下不同水平應力比對破壞方向的影響。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。~Separate remote stress from wall concentration in deep cover and examine how different horizontal stress ratios change damage orientation at the same depth. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=560 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=43.68 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為48.048 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: cover=560 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=43.68 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 48.048 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 把洞壁破壞方位與原位應力及節理方向比對，測試各模型是否預測同一高需求區。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare wall-damage orientation with stress and joints, testing whether alternative models predict the same critical zone. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 以覆土唯一決定應力會錯估側壁或拱頂哪處先受損，進而誤置觀測點。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。~Using cover alone can misidentify whether walls or crown govern and place monitoring at the wrong location. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.
units.misconception: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。~Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
units.practice: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：把洞壁破壞方位與原位應力及節理方向比對，測試各模型是否預測同一高需求區。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。~For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare wall-damage orientation with stress and joints, testing whether alternative models predict the same critical zone. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 哥達多地質區段的支護不能只以最終厚度比較，需把安裝距離和可容許變形納入，理解何時剛性過高反而增加局部需求。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~Compare support across ground domains using activation distance and deformation allowance, not final thickness alone, and identify when excess stiffness increases local demand. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=32 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。F=ku=224 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為246.4 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=32 kN/mm; movement=7 mm. F=ku=224 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 246.4 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按掌子面距離重排收斂與荷重資料，檢查不同區段能否用同一支護曲線解釋。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Replot convergence and load against face distance, testing whether one support curve explains different sections. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把不同安裝時點的讀值混合會誤判材料剛度，可能把施工順序問題當材料缺陷。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Mixing activation times biases inferred stiffness and can misclassify a sequence problem as a material defect. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：按掌子面距離重排收斂與荷重資料，檢查不同區段能否用同一支護曲線解釋。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Replot convergence and load against face distance, testing whether one support curve explains different sections. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.anchor: 襯砌環向壓縮~Lining hoop compression
units.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度~Ring force and joint flexibility
units.mechanism: 長基線隧道的襯砌須接收地盤、水壓及施工頂推等不同作用，哥達情境比較均勻外壓估算與接頭局部彎曲，避免只用厚度判斷可靠性。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。~For the long base-tunnel context, compare uniform-pressure lining estimates with local joint bending under ground, water and construction actions rather than judging reliability by thickness alone. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.34 MPa；半徑=3.3 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=3.20571 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.52629 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.34 MPa; radius=3.3 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=3.20571 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.52629 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 量測環向變形及接縫開口，將背填和水頭回升階段分開，再對照接頭剛度敏感度。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Measure ring distortion and joint gaps by grouting and head-recovery stage, comparing joint-stiffness sensitivity. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 相同平均應變可能掩蓋一處接縫轉動集中，局部防水需求會比整環平均更不利。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。~Identical mean strain can hide concentrated rotation at one joint with worse local sealing demand. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。~Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：量測環向變形及接縫開口，將背填和水頭回升階段分開，再對照接頭剛度敏感度。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。~For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Measure ring distortion and joint gaps by grouting and head-recovery stage, comparing joint-stiffness sensitivity. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

units.anchor: 有效掘進利用率~Effective boring utilisation
units.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時~Boring utilisation and equipment downtime
units.mechanism: 哥達施工循環可用來分離切削速率與多工作面的有效利用率，並追問刀具維修時間是否隨地質而改變，不能用最佳單班外推整段工期。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。~Separate cutting rate from multi-heading utilisation and test whether cutter maintenance changes with geology; a best shift cannot be extrapolated to the whole drive. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：切削速率=1.56 m/h；有效利用率=0.31 無因次。D=24vu=11.6064 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.767 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.56 m/h; utilisation=0.31 dimensionless. D=24vu=11.6064 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.767 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以完整停時分類配對地質及刀具檢查，另用班次時間閉合檢查有無重複計時。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Pair downtime classes with geology and cutter inspections, closing shift time to detect double-counting. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把換刀和出渣重疊時間加兩次會低估利用率，錯誤地支持增購機械的決策。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。~Double-counting overlapping cutter and spoil delays understates utilisation and can falsely justify more machinery. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.
units.misconception: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。~A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
units.practice: 本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：以完整停時分類配對地質及刀具檢查，另用班次時間閉合檢查有無重複計時。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。~For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Pair downtime classes with geology and cutter inspections, closing shift time to detect double-counting. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.

units.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸~Shared access and transport bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 哥達多工作面共用後勤的教學重點是串聯瓶頸，豎井、連絡通道和卸料區的能力不能在不同時間假設下相加。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。~The multiple-heading context highlights serial logistics bottlenecks: shafts, connecting galleries and unloading areas cannot be combined using inconsistent time assumptions. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
units.model: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=22 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=150.857 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為137.143 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=22 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=150.857 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 137.143 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 對同一日逐小時建立材料和出渣需求表，核對維修時段是否同步占用共用運輸節點。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Build hourly material and spoil demand for the same day and identify maintenance overlap at shared transport nodes. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 各面個別達成計畫但共同卸料區壅塞時，整體進度仍可能失守，應由網路而非單面診斷。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。~Faces may meet local plans while shared unloading congestion defeats overall progress, requiring a network-level diagnosis. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.
units.misconception: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。~Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
units.practice: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：對同一日逐小時建立材料和出渣需求表，核對維修時段是否同步占用共用運輸節點。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。~For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Build hourly material and spoil demand for the same day and identify maintenance overlap at shared transport nodes. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 哥達長距離貫通要區分方向傳遞、尺度及高程三類誤差，地下兩組控制網即使互相閉合，也可能共用同一錯誤地表基準。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~Distinguish orientation, scale and elevation errors over long breakthrough distances; two underground networks can close while sharing a wrong surface datum. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3240 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0408407 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0449248 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=3240 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0408407 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0449248 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 獨立重算地表至各工作面的轉換，對照原始角距和不同環境條件量測，保留誤差相關性。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Independently recompute transformations to each heading using raw observations under different conditions, retaining error correlations. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只報一個三維閉合量會掩蓋高程方向的系統偏差，使軌道銜接問題延後暴露。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~One three-dimensional closure magnitude can hide a systematic height bias until track connection. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：獨立重算地表至各工作面的轉換，對照原始角距和不同環境條件量測，保留誤差相關性。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently recompute transformations to each heading using raw observations under different conditions, retaining error correlations. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.title: 熱源分配與空氣顯熱~Heat sources and sensible-air removal
units.mechanism: 哥達深部岩體放熱與列車或施工機械熱源時間尺度不同，需比較穩態空氣熱帳與長期岩體溫度演化，避免把短時試驗當全年能力。深部岩體、列車和機械會向空氣持續放熱，空氣帶走的顯熱由質量流量與溫升決定。相同體積風量在不同密度下不具有相同散熱能力；濕度、岩體瞬變及水冷系統還需分開記帳，單一穩態熱平衡不能預測全部溫度尖峰。~Deep-rock heat evolves on a different timescale from trains or machinery; compare air balances with longer rock-temperature evolution rather than treating short trials as year-round capability. Deep rock, trains and machinery release heat to the air, whose sensible removal depends on mass flow and temperature rise. Equal volumetric flow at different density does not provide equal cooling. Moisture, transient rock heat and water cooling need separate accounts; a steady balance cannot predict every temperature peak or local worker exposure.
units.model: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；體積風量=84 m³/s；定壓比熱=1.005 kJ/(kg·K)；溫升=15 K。Q=ρVcpΔT=1519.56 kW。僅把體積風量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1671.52 kW。邊界：僅空氣顯熱，不含濕度潛熱及岩體瞬變；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; volume flow=84 m³/s; specific heat=1.005 kJ/(kg·K); temperature rise=15 K. Q=ρVcpΔT=1519.56 kW. Increasing only volume flow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1671.52 kW. Boundary: Sensible air heat only, excluding latent heat and rock transients. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將岩壁溫度、風量及機械負載分別保存，檢查停工降溫是否真的代表岩體熱源已消失。同步量測進出口溫濕度、風量及設備負載，分開平均與尖峰時段，用能量收支殘差檢查漏列熱源。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Retain wall temperature, airflow and machine load separately and test whether shutdown cooling truly indicates reduced rock heat. Synchronise inlet/outlet temperature, humidity, flow and equipment load, separate average and peak periods, and use energy residuals to identify missing sources. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 停機後空氣迅速降溫但岩體仍持續放熱，重新載入時可能很快回到高溫，需辨認熱儲存。把低密度空氣視為海平面空氣會高估散熱，局部熱點也可能被斷面平均溫度掩蓋，導致設備或工作環境超限。~Air cools quickly after shutdown while rock retains heat, so renewed loading can rapidly restore high temperatures. Assuming sea-level density overstates cooling at low density, while cross-sectional averages hide hot spots affecting equipment and the work environment.
units.misconception: 只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。~Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude.
units.practice: 本案「通風顯熱量」的交付需回答：將岩壁溫度、風量及機械負載分別保存，檢查停工降溫是否真的代表岩體熱源已消失。熱帳分別列岩體、交通、機械與水冷路徑，交接時保存季節和負載範圍，設備增設前須重新核對可用散熱能力。~For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the ventilation sensible heat handover must address the following evidence: Retain wall temperature, airflow and machine load separately and test whether shutdown cooling truly indicates reduced rock heat. Keep rock, traffic, machinery and water-cooling paths separate; retain seasonal and load ranges and reassess cooling capacity before adding equipment.

units.anchor: 入口壓力擾動~Portal pressure disturbance
units.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級~Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale
units.mechanism: 哥達高速鐵路的氣動檢核需配對列車編組、速度及隧道斷面，對向交會與門位改變會產生不同壓力歷程，不能只看動壓比例。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。~Pair formation, speed and cross-section for aerodynamic assessment; encounters and door states produce different pressure histories beyond simple dynamic-pressure scaling. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes. Speed and blockage influence magnitude, but incompressible dynamic pressure is only a comparison scale, not a compressible transient solution. Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=42 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1058.4 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1280.66 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=42 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1058.4 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1280.66 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 在不同里程同步記錄壓力波抵達時間，以傳播時間和反射時刻檢查模型邊界，而非只擬合峰值。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Record wave arrival at multiple chainages and use propagation and reflection timing to test boundaries rather than fitting peaks alone. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 錯誤邊界可能碰巧擬合最大值卻錯估升壓速率，設備承受的循環需求仍會不正確。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。~An incorrect boundary may match the peak accidentally while misrepresenting rise rate and cyclic equipment demand. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort.
units.misconception: 動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。~A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：在不同里程同步記錄壓力波抵達時間，以傳播時間和反射時刻檢查模型邊界，而非只擬合峰值。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。~For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Record wave arrival at multiple chainages and use propagation and reflection timing to test boundaries rather than fitting peaks alone. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 哥達交付從多個施工面整併成一個鐵路資產系統，需把不同承包界面、材料批次及試運轉版本連到同一里程，避免資料在土建與機電間斷裂。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Integrate multiple construction fronts into one railway asset system, linking contract interfaces, batches and commissioning revisions to chainage so civil and systems evidence remain connected. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=102 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.3137 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為82.7451 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=102 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.3137 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.7451 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查一段軌道附近設備，將竣工位置、供電路徑和控制版本追至對應施工及試驗紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Sample equipment near one track section and trace position, supply and control revision to construction and commissioning records. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 各標段檔案各自完整但里程原點不同，會讓相鄰設備對不上圖面，維修隔離可能定位錯誤。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Complete contract files with inconsistent chainage origins can mislocate adjacent assets and maintenance isolation. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查一段軌道附近設備，將竣工位置、供電路徑和控制版本追至對應施工及試驗紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample equipment near one track section and trace position, supply and control revision to construction and commissioning records. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，再獨立計算「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」。原創教學假設：覆土深度=560 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=43.68 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為48.048 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=22 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=150.857 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為137.143 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate cover stress and wall redistribution, then independently calculate shared access and transport bottlenecks. Original teaching assumptions: cover=560 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=43.68 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 48.048 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=22 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=150.857 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 137.143 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2016 年公開記錄：哥達基線隧道投入營運，成為瑞士平緩跨阿爾卑斯鐵路核心。哥達基線隧道長57公里，瑞士官方記錄2016年投入營運，服務平緩跨阿爾卑斯鐵路。本進階課由牽引效益及覆土應力出發，連接支護時序、襯砌接頭、多工作面物流及精密貫通；最後比較岩體熱與列車壓力擾動，說明土建完成仍須完成系統介面驗證。本課把「深覆土地應力、基線牽引與多工作面整合」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2016: Gotthard Base Tunnel enters service as a core of the Swiss low-gradient transalpine railway. The 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entered service in 2016 as part of Switzerland’s low-gradient transalpine railway. This advanced course connects traction benefits and cover stress to support timing, lining joints, multiple-heading logistics and precision breakthrough. It then compares rock heat and train pressure disturbances, explaining why civil completion still requires verification of operating-system interfaces. The course treats deep-cover stress, base-railway traction and multiple-heading integration as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 57 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 57 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2016 年事件：哥達基線隧道投入營運，成為瑞士平緩跨阿爾卑斯鐵路核心。~2016 event: Gotthard Base Tunnel enters service as a core of the Swiss low-gradient transalpine railway.

教學「洞壁切向應力」：覆土深度=560 m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=43.68 MPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching tangential wall stress: cover=560 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 43.68 MPa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「有效掘進利用率」：切削速率=1.56 m/h，其餘輸入依單元，結果=11.6064 m/day；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching effective boring utilisation: active penetration=1.56 m/h, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 11.6064 m/day; not measured or accepted project data.
教學「出渣運輸節拍」：車輛數=4 個，其餘輸入依單元，結果=150.857 t/h；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching muck-transport cycle: vehicles=4 count, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 150.857 t/h; not measured or accepted project data.
